create_OwlViTImageProcessor: create an OwlViTImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images for object detection
run_post_process_object_detection: run post_process_object_detection to convert model logits into filtered bounding boxes with scores and labels
run_post_process_image_guided_detection: run post_process_image_guided_detection to convert model outputs into COCO-format detections with NMS
test_box_iou: test the box_iou function to compute intersection-over-union between two sets of bounding boxes
test_box_area: test the box_area function to compute the area of bounding boxes given x1,y1,x2,y2 coordinates
